payments.emptyHint: Payments appear here when students pay on the website.
payments.noResultsHint: Change the filters or clear them to see all payments.

detail.title: Payment
detail.refundRequiredHint: This student paid after the session filled up. Move them to another session of the same course, or refund them in Paymob and record it here.

refund.title: Record refund
refund.description: For booking {reference}. Refund the money in the Paymob portal first, then record it here.
refund.consequence: Recording a refund marks the booking as Refunded and cancels the student's ticket. The seat becomes free.
refund.amountError: Enter an amount between 1 and {max} EGP.
refund.transactionHint: Shown in Paymob after you refund.
refund.transactionError: Enter the refund transaction ID from Paymob.

move.title: Move to another session
move.description: Choose a session with free seats for {name}.
move.none: No other session of this course has free seats. Add a session, or record a refund instead.
move.priceDifference: The prices differ (new / paid). Settle the difference with the student directly:
move.consequence: The booking becomes Paid in the new session and the student keeps the same ticket reference.
move.noSeats: That session just filled up. Choose another one.

cancel.title: Cancel this booking?
cancel.description: {name}'s booking {reference} will be cancelled, the ticket stops working and the seat becomes free. Refund the money in Paymob separately.
cancel.reasonError: Give a reason for the cancellation.

courses.emptyHint: Add your first course. Students can book it once it has a published session.
courses.archiveDescription: "{title}" will be hidden from the website. Students who already booked keep their tickets. You can restore it later.
courses.deleteDescription: "{title}" will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.

card.upcomingCount: {count, plural, =0 {No upcoming sessions} one {# upcoming session} other {# upcoming sessions}}

add.title: Add course
add.description: Start with the essentials. You'll add the content, curriculum and sessions next.
add.codeHint: 3 letters, used in session codes (e.g. ETB).
add.priceHint: Sessions use this price unless you change it.
add.shortDescriptionHint: One or two sentences shown on the course card.

errors.both: Enter the title in Arabic and English.
errors.codeTaken: Another course already uses this code.
errors.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
errors.slugTaken: Another course already uses this link.
errors.hours: Enter the total hours (a whole number).
errors.meetings: Enter the number of meetings (a whole number).

overview.codeLocked: Locked: sessions already use this code.
overview.slugLocked: Locked after publishing, so shared links keep working.
overview.priceHint: Changing it doesn't affect existing sessions or bookings.
overview.disciplineHint: Shown under the code on the generated cover.
overview.coverAltHint: Read by screen readers on the website.

content.aboutHint: What the course is and how it's taught.
content.outcomesHint: At least {min}, written as things the student will be able to do.

curriculum.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No modules} one {# module} other {# modules}} · {hours} of {planned} hours planned

faq.incomplete: Every question needs a question and an answer in Arabic and English.

publishing.readyHint: Everything required is filled in, in Arabic and English.

publishing.blocked: Complete the missing items before publishing.
publishing.archivedHint: This course is archived. Restore it from the Courses page to publish it again.
publishing.featuredHint: Featured courses appear in the home page's course section.
publishing.comingSoonHint: Shown as "Coming soon" while the course has no session open for booking.
publishing.comingSoonNoteHint: For example: first session expected in January.
publishing.registrationClosedHint: Hides the booking button for every session of this course.
publishing.seoTitleHint: About 60 characters. Shown in Google results and browser tabs.
publishing.seoDescriptionHint: About 160 characters. The summary under the title in Google results.

form.meetingsHint: Date, start and end time of each meeting, in Cairo time.
form.publishedHint: Unpublished sessions are hidden from students but keep their bookings.

errors.noMeetings: Add at least one meeting with a date and times.
errors.firstInPast: The first meeting must be in the future.
